ns2:section.sectionText: Topics in History of Instrumental Music (Virtuoso Piano Literature, 1700-2000) This course will examine a range of virtuosic piano works beginning in 1741 with Bach’s Goldberg Variations and ending in 1998 with John Zorn’s Carny. In between, works that made particularly rigorous demands on the performer will be examined to discover the expressive and aesthetic techniques used in their composition. Other composers covered may include Beethoven, Brahms, Liszt, Chopin, Ravel, Carter, Messiaen, Sorabji, Xenakis, and Ferneyhough.
